target_claim.statement: Basal single-cell expression features, especially Nfkbia, are exploratorily associated with the subsequent rate of LPS-induced Tnf-mCherry increase in the observed Live-seq RAW cells.

search_fingerprint.biological_system: RAW264.7-like macrophages exposed to LPS with single-cell transcriptomic and dynamic inflammatory-response measurements
search_fingerprint.cell_state: unstimulated or pre-response macrophage state linked to a subsequent inflammatory phenotype
search_fingerprint.phenotype_outcome: Tnf-promoter activity, NF-kB signaling dynamics, or a documented biologically comparable single-cell inflammatory-response phenotype
search_fingerprint.assay: single-cell transcriptomics paired at cell level, or in a defensibly matched design, with live-cell or fluorescent dynamic phenotyping
search_fingerprint.time_structure: pre-response molecular state linked to a later response is preferred; post-stimulation matched-cell studies are descriptive context rather than direct replication
search_fingerprint.required_biological_unit: independently generated biological material from an experiment unrelated to GSE141064, with a source-backed grouping key above cells and technical containers
acceptable_substitutions: same-cell NF-kB dynamics paired with scRNA-seq in an independent experiment whose biological grouping is documented
primary mouse macrophage NF-kB dynamics plus scRNA-seq with documented biological replication
single-cell transcriptomics paired with a fluorescent inflammatory phenotype and an established independent unit
unacceptable_substitutions: alternate plates, runs, lanes, libraries, prefixes, or cells treated as biological replicates
shared donor, clone preparation, culture, extraction event, or pooled material
a new accession that only republishes or repartitions target samples

candidates.title: Measuring signaling and RNA-Seq in the same cell links gene expression to dynamic patterns of NF-kB activation
candidates.rationale: GSE94383 is a separate public RAW264.7 experiment with matched NF-kB trajectories and transcriptomes. A weak positive association is visible within its 823-cell table, but the independent biological unit and ID-prefix semantics are unresolved. Cell-level bootstrap, permutation, and prefix exclusion are descriptive sensitivity only and cannot establish independent biological support, conceptual replication, or generalization. Its transcriptome is also post-stimulation, so timing differs from the target claim.

candidates.title: Six distinct NF-kB signaling codons convey discrete information to distinguish stimuli and enable appropriate macrophage responses
candidates.rationale: The study is relevant to macrophage NF-kB dynamics, but the public evidence does not establish the same temporal target or a compatible independent-unit contract.

candidates.title: Single cell time course of macrophages exposed to Salmonella enterica subsp. typhimurium
candidates.rationale: This is useful inflammatory single-cell method context, but stimulus, phenotype, and temporal target differ materially.

candidates.title: Single cell analysis of macrophages exposed to LPS-coated beads
candidates.rationale: The dataset provides method and inflammatory-heterogeneity context but not a compatible predictor-to-later-phenotype test.

candidates.title: NF-kB dynamics determine stimulus-specific epigenomic reprogramming in macrophages
candidates.rationale: The bulk transcriptomic and epigenomic design cannot reproduce the paired single-cell temporal claim.

candidates.title: Within-study Nfkbia-BFP to Tnf-mCherry validation
candidates.rationale: This is valuable within-study construct validation but not external independent replication.

independence_leakage_findings.finding: The analysed cell count and ID-prefix diversity cannot substitute for a source-backed independent biological unit. Until grouping semantics are resolved, cell-level uncertainty summaries are descriptive only.
A separate validation inside the same publication cannot be promoted to external replication.
The molecular measurement follows stimulation, whereas the target asks whether a basal transcript predicts a later Tnf-promoter response.

prespecified_test.primary_endpoint: Describe the within-table direction of association between post-LPS Nfkbia expression and recent preceding same-cell NF-kB activity after harvest-time stratification.
prespecified_test.expected_direction: Positive within-table direction; no inferential support verdict is available without an established independent unit.
prespecified_test.biological_grouping_key: Unresolved. Individual cells and ID prefixes are not accepted as independent biological units.
exclusion_criteria: cell, prefix, plate, library, lane, or run used as biological replication
post hoc feature selection based on favorable Nfkbia output
prespecified_test.success_criteria: No inferential replication success criterion is admissible until a source-backed independent biological unit is established. The current run may report descriptive rho and sensitivity summaries only.
prespecified_test.observed_result: A weak positive within-table association was observed across 823 matched cell records. Cell-level bootstrap, permutation, and prefix-exclusion outputs remain non-inferential because effective biological N is unresolved.

next_valid_action: Resolve source-backed biological grouping for GSE94383 and continue searching for a temporally compatible independent dataset before assigning any replication or external-validation status.

safety_status.notes: No candidate currently satisfies the independent-unit and temporal requirements for accepted replication.
